organism: Taniguchi et al. 2010 (doi:10.1126/science.1188308): gamma-distributed protein numbers; noise falls with the mean at low expression (CV2 ~ 1/mean, slope -1 in log-log) and is dominated by extrinsic noise at high expression (a floor)
in_sample: emergent; seeds share every parameter, so cell-to-cell parameter variation is absent
reader_note: protein counts as MonomerCounts records them; the five two-component sensors (BV-R1) are not corrected here, which does not move a scaling law over about 4,000 proteins
